name: crystoline/xpsr-lock
description: Locks for XPSR applications on Symfony Lock: files, Redis, Redlock across several Redis servers, and the application's database

suggest.crystoline/xpsr-database: The database store (lock.store database) and php xpsr make:lock-table
suggest.symfony/cache: The Redis and Redlock stores, with the phpredis extension or predis/predis
suggest.predis/predis: A Redis client written in PHP, for Redis and Redlock without the phpredis extension
